name: Kinouchi Nei
source:
She is the only daughter of the Kinouchi Ryokan.

Although she was spoiled whilst growing up, she has an easygoing personality.

She is the type who gets absorbed in things that interest her. Surprisingly, she is also considerate of others.

From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=6489]getchu[/url]]
